article_notes: Cross-sectional PCR/serology survey of 372 dogs on St Kitts (teaching hospital and free community clinics). Table 1 tabulates, for each infection category (B. vogeli only, B. vogeli with E. canis, B. gibsoni only, etc.), the proportion of dogs with signs of a tick-borne disease and with laboratory abnormalities. These are per-exposure-group descriptive proportions in largely subclinical carriers, with no test and no severity or outcome grouping of babesiosis cases; not extracted as severity rows (see not_extracted). E. canis copy number vs clinical signs concerns E. canis, not Babesia.

not_extracted.what: Signs of tick-borne disease and laboratory abnormalities by Babesia species and by co-infection with E. canis (Table 1)
not_extracted.note: Descriptive proportions per infection category in mostly subclinical dogs; 'signs of a tick-borne disease' is not a babesiosis severity definition, no test, and small cells (e.g. 1/12, 2/8). Not extracted as a severity association.
